name: plan-writer-operation-flags-by-example
body: The plan-writer template names the task operation-flag family by example — `--module-create`, `--file-modify`, … — rather than enumerating all twenty flags. Limit: the template's example list is not exhaustive, so a reader must consult the CLI for the full set. Upgrade: extend the example list (or enumerate the family) whenever the CLI's operation-flag set changes, so the template cannot fall out of step silently.
